description: Source file implementing kernel-related shell commands for Zephyr RTOS, including version, uptime, thread and stack info, heap stats, reboot, and logging level controls.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_uptime
methods.description: Displays kernel uptime, optionally in a pretty format.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_cycles
methods.description: Displays the number of hardware cycles since boot.

methods.name: shell_tdata_dump
methods.description: Dumps detailed info about a thread, including stack usage and runtime stats.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_threads
methods.description: Lists all kernel threads with their statuses.

methods.name: shell_stack_dump
methods.description: Dumps stack usage info for a thread.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_stacks
methods.description: Lists stack usage for all threads and interrupt stacks.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_heap
methods.description: Shows runtime statistics of the kernel heap.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_log_level_set
methods.description: Sets log level for a specific module.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_reboot_warm
methods.description: Performs a warm reboot of the system.

methods.name: cmd_kernel_reboot_cold
methods.description: Performs a cold reboot of the system.
